title: Identity principles — landscape arrangement

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Let a reader compare independent ingredients together so flexibility remains anchored to recognizable common choices.
strategic_value: A compact overview can explain how Audi keeps identity coherent without fixing every composition.
demonstration: Eight animated tiles form two rows of four on black, comparing imagery, typography, moving presence, proportions, rings, icons, colors and logo ending.
practical_value: Use the overview to distinguish a shared ingredient from one particular layout.

content_islands.name: Upper row
content_islands.spec: Place imagery, flexible typography, moving presence and simple proportions left to right.

content_islands.name: Lower row
content_islands.spec: Place ring placement, technical icons, equally weighted colors and logo ending below with their captions.

reference_purposes.Expression: Eight tiles demonstrate the visual behavior of the identity ingredients.
reference_purposes.Application: The tiled arrangement compares alternate proportions, mark placements and typographic uses.
reference_purposes.Intent: KMS’s adjacent Principles instead of rules section explains why the identity uses simplified elements and flexible placement.

ingredient.name: Principle-based identity ingredients
ingredient.role: Keep varied expressions recognizable without one fixed composition.
ingredient.application: Compare ring placement, flexible type, color, imagery and proportions as coordinated choices. The source explicitly allows free logo placement and describes equally weighted brand colors; it does not mandate identical color area in every composition.
ingredient.scope: Historical KMS TEAM Audi case study; portrait and landscape overviews of the same system, not a complete current Audi manual.
